body: Slice 0 PR up for your review (merge gate): PR #926 (TASK-832, child of STORY-621). resolve_glab_binary + forge-keyed CLI dispatch — the confirmed-missing foundation for the gh-to-glab migration. Pure addition, GitHub behavior byte-for-byte unchanged (resolve_gh_binary kept as a thin wrapper). Rebased on current main; verified green: build, fmt --check, clippy correctness, and 2 unit tests (caught+fixed an EnvVarGuard double-hold deadlock in the test draft before pushing). glab resolver + dispatcher are dead_code-allowed, wired in follow-on slices. NOT self-merging. Slice 1 (route PR create/merge/open-PR-for-branch through the Forge trait) is next once this lands — I will rebase Slice 1 on the merged Slice 0. No overlap with your BUG-559/BUG-560 substrate lane.
